HBDND5E.API.Description: D&D-spezifische Ergänzungsmodule können vollständige Werteblöcke oder atomar vollständige Monsterpakete registrieren. Andere Spielsysteme implementieren den systemneutralen Adaptervertrag des Kernmoduls.
HBDND5E.API.Reference: Siehe docs/API.md und docs/SYSTEM-ADAPTERS.md des Kernmoduls.
HBDND5E.Actions.Label: Dashboard-Aktionen
HBDND5E.App.Heading: Hunter's Bestiary - D&D 5e 2024
HBDND5E.App.Introduction: Ergänzt das systemneutrale Jägerbestiar um native D&D-5e-2024-NSC-Akteure, W20-Feldproben, Erntegegenstände und Begegnungsmetadaten.
HBDND5E.App.Title: Hunter's Bestiary - D&D 5e 2024
HBDND5E.Common.NoResults: Keine Einträge entsprechen der aktuellen Suche.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.ashback_troll: A plated fist trailing scalding ash.
The troll vents stored heat in a 15-foot burst; the attack represents the hottest point of the blast.
A heat-retaining plate used in fireproof armor and forge linings.
A gland that produces dense mineral soot for alchemy.
A creature that hits the troll with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes 3 fire damage while the troll has at least half its Hit Points.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.bone_orchard_: Fungal shelves and mineralized antlers tear through armor.
A hoof strike bursts a cloud of bone-white spores.
old battlefields reclaimed by birch forest
ruined grave roads rich in pale fungi
Mineral-fed fungus used in restorative and funerary preparations.
A living antler shelf that can cultivate rare medicinal molds.
At the start of its turn while touching natural earth, the elk regains 5 Hit Points unless it took fire damage since its previous turn.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.carrion_bell_: A venomous bite that rings nearby bone chimes.
A snapping web line strung with sharpened fragments.
Silk that transmits vibration with exceptional clarity.
Venom used in compounds that disrupt balance and hearing.
A creature restrained by the spider's web cannot benefit from being hidden from the spider.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.choirback_toa: A sticky tongue lashes out with a resonant crack.
The back sacs release a focused pulse of sound.
marsh shrines and drowned stone circles
An elastic air sac used in instruments and warning devices.
Adhesive slime that carries vibration through wet surfaces.
Allied Tiny beasts within 20 feet of the toad have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.cinderwing_dr: A hot bite followed by a choking ash exhalation.
A fan of embers released from porous wing scales.
warm fumarole caves and slag fields
A porous wing sheet used in heat filters and ember-catching cloaks.
A scale that safely holds a small live coal for hours.
The drake is resistant to fire damage and sheds lightly obscuring ash when it takes slashing damage.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.coppercap_jac: A quick bite delivered while packmates distract the quarry.
Copper-green spores burst from the cultivated caps.
dry ruins where copper coins and pipes corrode
A cultivated fungus used in scent-masking powders.
An antimicrobial oil valuable for leather care and field medicine.
A creature hit by the jackal's spore attack cannot benefit from scent-based tracking until the end of its next turn.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.dustmantle_bu: A digging claw reinforced with compacted mineral soil.
A sudden upward impact from beneath the target.
dry cropland above chalk and clay
wind-carved steppe with abandoned badger warrens
A layered soil plate useful in ablative armor.
An organ that detects and amplifies underground motion.
The first time each round the burrower takes damage, reduce that damage by 5 unless the damage is thunder.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.embercrop_man: A crushing bite hot with fermented mineral grit.
Explosive cinders launched from the throat crop.
A volatile organ used in controlled blasting compounds.
A hollow spine that can carry and ignite mineral powder.
The manticore can store mineral grit. Its cinder attacks ignore resistance to fire from nonmagical sources.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.fen_lantern_m: A puff of luminous wing dust irritates eyes and lungs.
Blue luminous dust used in trail markers and dim lamps.
Fine waterproof silk gathered from a moth roost.
In fog or darkness, the moth can appear as a distant handheld lantern to creatures more than 30 feet away.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.gloamfang_cou: Black fangs strike from the boundary between light and shade.
A descending pair of claws after a silent leap.
ravines where sunlight reaches only briefly
A whisker that twitches near abrupt changes in illumination.
Dark fur used in stealth garments and light-dampening inks.
While in dim light, the cougar can Hide even when only lightly obscured.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.gravewind_hye: A bite accompanied by a disorienting whistle from its mane.
A fast pass that tears clothing and exposed flesh.
dry battlefields and exposed tomb roads
A hollow mane segment used for eerie signal whistles.
A porous fang that carries sound unusually well.
The hyena has advantage on attack rolls while an allied gravewind hyena is within 10 feet of its target.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.hollow_eyed_w: A crushing bite guided by pressure changes.
A tail strike that sends a pressure wave through stone.
mine networks with strong air currents
A sensitive hollow-eye nodule used in seismic instruments.
A bone that hums near unstable caverns and buried chambers.
The wyrm cannot be blinded and perceives creatures through solid stone within its tremorsense range if they move.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.ironjaw_lindw: Iron-coated plates clamp around weapon and prey alike.
A low sweep capable of clearing a riverbank.
Naturally metal-coated jaw plate used by master smiths.
Corrosive bile that softens common metals before forging.
The lindworm deals double damage to unattended nonmagical metal objects and can smell worked metal within 300 feet.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.lanternjaw_ee: A wide lower jaw snaps shut around prey.
The blue lure releases a short electrical pulse.
deep millponds connected to cave systems
A durable bioluminescent organ useful in underwater lamps.
A conductive spine used in simple shock traps.
Aquatic beasts with Intelligence 3 or lower are reluctant to move closer to the eel's lure unless threatened.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.mireglass_bas: Its translucent jaws fracture light around the wound.
A sudden many-legged rush that appears to come from the wrong direction.
sunken roads bordered by pale reeds
A translucent scale prized for lenses and warding mirrors.
A carefully bottled eye fluid used in immobilizing compounds.
The basilisk has advantage on saving throws against effects it can see while it is in dim light or brighter.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.mirrorhide_ly: Reflective plates repeat the motion of the striking claw.
A leap that fractures surrounding color into cutting light.
misty conifer slopes above still tarns
A thin reflective plate used in illusion-breaking optics.
Fur that retains nearby colors for several hours after removal.
The first attack roll made against the lynx each round has disadvantage unless the attacker can see invisible creatures.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.moonveil_stag: Cold luminous antlers pass through mist before striking.
A hoof strike delivered from an impossible angle.
A cold-glowing antler shard used in wayfinding charms.
Condensed mist that briefly obscures tracks and scent.
Opportunity attacks against the stag are made with disadvantage, as nearby paths seem to shift around it.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.reed_crowned_: A crushing bite from beneath a living reed mat.
A broad sweep that preserves the reed colony on its back.
slow rivers choked with reed islands
flooded rice fields and abandoned canals
A hardy reed strain used in camouflage screens and wetland restoration.
A broad scale naturally patterned like marsh vegetation.
While motionless in marsh vegetation, the crocodile is heavily obscured from creatures more than 20 feet away.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.rimehorn_auro: Layered ice blades extend from the horn cores.
A heavy stomp scatters razor frost.
A horn core that slowly freezes exposed moisture.
Dense rendered fat used in cold-weather salves and lamps.
After moving 20 feet straight, the aurochs' horn attack deals an extra 2d8 cold damage.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.saltmarsh_mir: A broad pincer closes through mud and armor.
The creature surges from beneath saturated ground.
tidal mudflats and salt reed beds
A resonant organ used in vibration-sensitive devices.
Salt-hardened plates suitable for shields and field armor.
The mireclaw knows the location of moving creatures touching the same body of water or saturated earth within 60 feet.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.stormglass_ro: A translucent beak crackling with static.
Massive talons discharge stored storm energy.
high ridges struck repeatedly by lightning
A translucent feather that stores a dangerous static charge.
An organ used in weather instruments and lightning wards.
When the roc takes lightning damage, it gains 20 temporary Hit Points instead of taking the first 20 points of that damage.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.thornhide_boa: A sweeping tusk strike through living thorn mats.
The boar drives its armored shoulder into its prey.
A rigid thorn-bristle suitable for traps and reinforcing leather.
A section of living hide that remains tough when properly cured.
If the boar moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target before hitting it, the target takes an extra 2d6 piercing damage.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.veinroot_colo: A root fist armored with raw ore nodules.
Mineral roots erupt from the ground beneath a target.
landslide scars where bedrock lies exposed
A regenerating ore growth used in legendary forging experiments.
Dense heartwood that conducts magical and mineral energy.
The colossus has advantage on saving throws while touching unworked earth or stone and cannot be moved against its will there.
HBDND5E.Content.Statblocks.whitewake_ser: A vast bite hidden beneath aerated water.
A keeled body sweep that churns water into a blinding wake.
pack-ice channels and deep coastal shelves
A scale keel used in exceptional ship fittings and water wards.
A bladder capable of producing vast quantities of fine bubbles.
The serpent does not provoke opportunity attacks while swimming, and creatures following directly in its wake have disadvantage on attacks against it.
HBDND5E.Delete.PreserveUnmanaged: Akteure und Gegenstände ohne exakte Modulherkunft werden nicht gelöscht.
HBDND5E.Delete.PreserveUserContent: Benutzererstellte Dokumente, nicht zugehörige Ordner und nicht zugehörige eingebettete Inhalte bleiben erhalten.
HBDND5E.Delete.Scope: Löscht ausschließlich Akteure und Gegenstände mit exakter Herkunftskennzeichnung von Hunter's Bestiary und D&D 5e 2024. Nicht verwaltete und benutzererstellte Inhalte bleiben erhalten.
